plan.summary: This 4-week block starts a 12-week off-camp boxing S&C plan built around one efficient weekly session that supports high skill and sparring volume. Week 1 establishes training maxes for the main lower-body lift so percentage work can start cleanly, and the main training work begins in Week 2. With only one lifting day per week, the session prioritizes power first, then main strength, then practical upper-body and trunk accessories.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build foundational strength and general power with low-complexity lifts that do not interfere with boxing work.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress strength and power steadily while trimming any extra fatigue that competes with sparring.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep strength in place and express it through faster, sharper power and speed-focused work.

exercises.name: Box Jump
exercises.notes: Use a low box you can land on cleanly. Reset between reps and focus on a fast takeoff with a quiet landing.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use bodyweight only and keep each rep crisp.

substitutionOptions.name: Countermovement Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Land softly and stop the set if jump height drops.

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.notes: Warm up with several small jumps in load, then work up to one hard but technically solid top set. Brace hard, keep depth consistent, and stop if form breaks.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your heaviest clean set of 3-5 reps. This sets your baseline for future percentage work.
